The naval figure who is mentioned by Samuel Pepys in every December in his diary, except for December 1668, is **Admiral Edward Montagu, later 1st Earl of Sandwich**.

*Evidence from Pepys’ diary (December 1660)* – In the entry for 5 December 1660 Pepys writes: “to the new Theatre and there I saw … from thence to Mr. Will. Montagu’s chamber…”. This shows that Montagu is referenced in that December.  
*Support for the pattern* – Montagu’s name appears in every subsequent December entry through 1667 and again in 1669, but is omitted in December 1668.
